use: Separate and quantify components (purity, yield; needs standards).
simulation: Peaks generated from retention times, area proportional to concentration; peaks are unlabeled, compare against standards.
notes: Reference model profile: HPLC (reversed-phase C18, UV detection)
Spec values not individually verified (verified = false). Chromatographic behaviour is purely a model assumption.
sources: Agilent 1260 Infinity II product literature (to be archived and checked)

inject.description: Inject and run one chromatogram (~10 min). Result is a peak list [{rt_min, area}]; peaks are unnamed, use standards for identification and quantitation
